task_definition.task_description: Please check the current time in New York, then look up the details for Hilton Tokyo and book a standard room there for John Doe from 2026-02-22 to 2025-07-05. After that, check the weather in New York, find Alice’s contact information, and then send her an app alert with medium priority saying the hotel was booked successfully.

user_input.query: Please check the current time in New York using the America/New_York timezone, then look up the details for Hilton Tokyo and book a standard room there for John Doe from 2026-02-22 to 2025-07-05. After that, check the weather in New York, find alice’s contact information, and send her an app alert with medium priority saying that the hotel was booked successfully.
